articles.title: Cinco Spark

articles.title: Mayan Jade
articles.summary: Deep green and gold folk tile pattern with hearts, scorpion, palm, satin sparkle. A saturated folk-art quilt: mustard, teal and red tiles on dark outlines.
articles.what: Mexican-inspired cultural lacquer texture with cleaned poster artwork and paired high-detail spec map depth.
